# 4.83 Eighty-third assembly district.

(1) That part of the town of Waukesha comprising U.S. census tract 201300, blocks 4004, 4007, 4010, 4012, 4013, and 4017; and tract 201600, blocks 2009, 2010, 2011, 2012, 2013, 2014, 2015, 2016, 2018, 2019, 2020, 3011, 3012, and 3013; and tract 202102, blocks 4000, 4001, 4002, 4003, 4004, 4005, 4007, 4008, 4009, 4010, 4011, 4013, 4014, 4015, 4016, 4017, 4035, 4040, 4041, 4042, 4043, 4044, 4045, 4046, 4047, and 4048; and tract 202103, blocks 1003, 1005, 1006, 1008, 1009, 1016, 1019, 1022, 1024, 1025, 1026, 1027, 1030, 1031, 1032, 1037, 1038, 2000, 2001, 2002, 2003, 2004, 2005, 2006, 2007, 2008, 2009, 2010, 2011, 2012, 2013, 2014, 2015, 2016, 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020, and 2021; and tract 202301, blocks 3017, 3020, 3021, 3022, 3024, 3027, 3028, 3029, 3041, 3042, 3043, and 3045; and tract 202303, blocks 3025, 3026, 3027, 3028, 3029, 3031, 3032, 3033, 3034, 3035, and 3036; and tract 202400, blocks 1007, 1009, 1019, 1020, 1021, 2005, 4004, and 4005; and tract 202500, blocks 1000, 1001, 1002, 1003, 1004, 1005, 1028, 3000, 3002, 3008, 3009, 3010, 3014, 3016, 3017, 3018, 3019, 3020, 3021, 5001, and 5002; and tract 202800, blocks 1029 and 1030; and tract 202902, blocks 3009, 3010, and 3018.
